faq_desc: The most common questions about Erasmus+, the application process, and using the platform.
faq_a1: Nomad Youth is a digital platform created so young people can find Erasmus+, volunteering, internship, grant, training and other development opportunities in one place. Here you can explore opportunities that match your interests and go directly to the official application links.
faq_q2: Does Nomad Youth organize the projects itself?
faq_a2: No. Nomad Youth does not organize projects directly. We collect opportunities shared by various organizations in one platform and direct you to the official application page.
faq_a3: Erasmus+ is the European Union's international program supporting education, youth, training and sports. Under this program, young people can take part in training, youth exchanges, volunteering programs and other development opportunities in different countries.
faq_q4: What's the difference between Erasmus+ and a Youth Exchange?
faq_a4: Erasmus+ is the name of the overall program. Youth Exchange is one of the short-term youth exchange formats organized under Erasmus+. Young people from different countries come together around a topic, learn, and share experiences.
faq_a5: ESC — European Solidarity Corps — is a program mainly intended for volunteering activities. Participants can take part in social, cultural or environmental projects in different countries.
faq_a6: No. Young people in Azerbaijan can apply to Erasmus+ and other international opportunities. Each project simply has different participating countries, age range and application requirements. It's important to carefully check each listing's conditions.
faq_q7: Who can apply to Erasmus+ projects?
faq_a7: This varies from project to project. Many Youth Exchange projects are for the 18–30 age range, but there are also opportunities open to 13–17, 30+, and even 35+ participants. Each project's age and participation requirements should be checked separately.
faq_q8: Is participation in Erasmus+ projects paid?
faq_a8: Most Erasmus+ projects cover training, accommodation and food costs. Some projects may require a small participation fee or travel costs paid upfront. We recommend checking the financial terms before applying.
faq_q9: Are travel, accommodation and food costs covered?
faq_a9: Many Erasmus+ projects cover accommodation, food and activity costs. Travel costs may be reimbursed afterward up to a certain limit, or partially covered. Exact details are stated in the project listing.
faq_q10: How can I apply to an Erasmus+ project?
faq_a10: Choose the project that suits you, read the requirements carefully, and click the "Apply" button. This button will take you to the project's official application page or the form provided by the organizer.
faq_q11: Do I need to be fluent in English?
faq_a11: No. For most projects, a basic level of English that allows you to communicate is enough. The main thing is to participate actively and be open to learning. Some professional programs may require a higher language level.
faq_q12: Why do I need a CV and a motivation letter?
faq_a12: A CV gives brief information about your education, experience and skills. A motivation letter explains why you want to join that project. Not every project requires these documents, but when they do, they matter for your application.
faq_q13: Can I apply to several projects at the same time?
faq_a13: Yes. You can apply to several projects at the same time. Tailoring each application to the specific project gives better results.
faq_q14: Is Nomad Youth responsible for my application or acceptance result?
faq_a14: No. Nomad Youth presents opportunities on one platform and directs you to the official application page. Evaluating the application and the acceptance result is the responsibility of the organization running the project.
faq_q15: How can I share my project on Nomad Youth?
faq_a15: If you are an organization or initiative creating opportunities for young people, you can contact us to share your project on the Nomad Youth platform. We'll be happy to respond and discuss how to reach more young people and potential collaboration.
faq_q16: How can I partner with Nomad Youth?
faq_a16: Nomad Youth is open to collaboration with organizations, initiatives and companies that create opportunities for young people. Contact us to discuss reaching a wider audience, joint activities and mutual visibility opportunities.

modal_privacy_content:
Last updated: July 2026

Nomad Youth is a digital platform that helps young people more easily find Erasmus+, volunteering, internship, grant, training and other development opportunities. This document explains how your information is collected and used when you use the Nomad Youth platform, and the rules for using the platform.
Nomad Youth currently operates as an independent initiative.

1. Information we collect
During registration we may collect the following information:
First and last name
Email address
Password
Phone number
Date of birth
Areas of interest
University
Education level
Major
When you sign up with Google, basic profile information you agree to share from your Google account may also be obtained.
Information about opportunities you select, save, or mark as "applied" while using the platform may also be stored in your account.

2. How we use your information
We may use the information we collect for the following purposes:
To create and manage your account;
To show you relevant opportunities;
To help you track the projects you have saved and applied to;
To improve the platform's functioning, security, and user experience;
To respond to your inquiries and requests;
With your separate consent, to send you emails about Erasmus+, volunteering, internships, and other opportunities.

3. Email notifications
Email notifications are sent only if you have given separate consent. You can unsubscribe from email notifications at any time.

4. Sharing of information
Nomad Youth does not sell your personal information and does not share it with third parties for commercial purposes.
Information may only be used when necessary for the platform's operation, technical maintenance, security, and compliance with legal obligations.
When you apply to a project listed on the Nomad Youth platform, you are directed to that project's official application page or the organizer's form. From that point on, the information you provide is subject to that organization's own rules and privacy policy.

5. Data storage and security
Your information is stored in the database system used to operate the platform. We try to take appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your information.
However, it is not possible to guarantee the complete security of information transmitted over the internet.

6. Account deletion and access to information
Users can delete their account through the platform. When an account is deleted, the personal information associated with it is deleted from the system or anonymized where possible.
If you have any questions, corrections, or deletion requests regarding your information, you can contact us:
Email: nomadyouthplatform@gmail.com

7. Cookies and analytics
Nomad Youth may use cookies and similar technologies to operate the platform, improve user experience, and analyze traffic.
If Google AdSense or other advertising services are used in the future, those services may apply their own cookie and privacy rules.
modal_terms_content:
Last updated: July 2026

8. Rules for using the platform
When using the Nomad Youth platform, you must:
Provide accurate and up-to-date information;
Not use another person's account without authorization;
Not take actions that would obstruct the platform's operation, compromise its security, or cause damage;
Not copy, distribute, or use the platform's information in bulk without authorization or for commercial purposes.

9. Responsibility for projects and outcomes
Nomad Youth does not organize projects directly and only presents opportunities on one platform. Evaluating applications, acceptance or rejection decisions, running the project, payments, travel, visas, safety, and other processes are the direct responsibility of the organization running the project.
Nomad Youth does not guarantee acceptance to any project, obtaining a visa, financial support, or any specific outcome.

10. Responsibility for services
Nomad Youth may offer CV preparation, Europass CV, motivation letter, application support, Erasmus consulting, and other support services.
These services are intended to support the user during the application process and do not guarantee acceptance to any project, obtaining a visa, or any other outcome.
The terms, price, and payment method for a service are agreed upon separately once contact has been made with the user.

11. Changes
Nomad Youth may update this Privacy Policy and Terms of Use from time to time. The updated version will be published on this page, and the last updated date will be noted.

12. Contact
If you have any questions, suggestions, or requests regarding this document, you can contact us:
Email: nomadyouthplatform@gmail.com
